title: Portugal (Algarve) · One Easy Lagos Base — June 2027

itinerary.labelHtml:
Day by Day

Seven nights without changing rooms

Arrival and departure frame seven Lagos nights. Every swim and excursion has a pool, town or rest alternative.

days.heading: Pittsburgh → Faro
days.note: Use one protected ticket and avoid a self-transfer; exact June 2027 flights still need confirmation.

days.heading: Arrive, unpack once + pool
days.note: A shower, groceries and early sleep are enough. Pool time is a bonus, not an obligation.

days.note: Walk the old town in the cooler morning, then choose a short beach session rather than an all-day commitment.

spots.cost: Old town, marina and Meia Praia are free. Budget only for a short taxi or local bus when the preferred beach entrance is too far to walk; verify the live timetable and fare in 2027.
spots.climate: About 64–80°F air; Atlantic water roughly 68–72°F. The beach is optional, while a lodging pool gives the family a more dependable warm-water choice.
spots.saveHtml: Save Walk the old town, picnic from the supermarket and use one short taxi to the sand.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Pay more for a walkable apartment or family room with a pool, kitchen, air conditioning and four real beds.
spots.restoHtml:

spots.cost: The boardwalks and viewpoints are free. A licensed short boat is an optional 2027-priced add-on only when the operator confirms calm conditions that morning.
spots.climate: Expect refreshing water and exposed cliffs. Check official flags, wind and swell before swimming; use railings and keep children away from unprotected edges.
spots.saveHtml: Save Make the free clifftop route the guaranteed experience and skip the boat if price, swell or queues disappoint.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Choose a small licensed boat with a written weather policy rather than a long coast cruise.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pomò — pasta after the cliffs
  • Nah Nah Bah — burgers and fries
  • Carry water and a picnic so a cliff outing never depends on a beach concession.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Boardwalk only if boats stop.
  • Pool or Meia Praia if stairs, heat or wind make Camilo a poor fit.

spots.cost: Budget for a small-group day tour or a prepriced driver. Fortress admission and the exact family transport total require a 2027 recheck; scenery, not a paid attraction, is the day’s payoff.
spots.climate: Usually cooler and windier than Lagos. Bring a light layer, keep well back from cliffs and treat swimming as off the agenda unless a guarded beach is clearly calm.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book a simple shared tour with Lagos pickup and a defined return time.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Use a private driver only if the family wants shorter stops and a guaranteed early return.
spots.restoHtml:
• aSagres — traditional restaurant; check the children’s options
  • Bahari — published burgers and fries
  • Pack familiar snacks in case the day-tour lunch stop is not a fit.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Lagos pool + Dona Ana viewpoints if wind or heat makes the west coast unattractive.
  • Praia da Luz for a shorter change of scenery.

spots.cost: The beach, promenade and village walks are free. Preprice short taxis if the local bus timing is awkward; do not turn a relaxed day into a timetable exercise.
spots.climate: Similar 64–80°F coastal air with cool Atlantic water. Check flags before entering and return to the Lagos pool when wind or surf rises.
spots.saveHtml: Save Choose Praia da Luz alone and use a local bus only when its timetable is convenient.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A prebooked taxi loop makes the Luz–Burgau pairing easy without renting a car.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pizzaria Luzzo — Roman- or Neapolitan-style pizza
  • TOMIK — Praia da Luz brunch and casual meals
  • Bring a backup sandwich or snack for Burgau.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Promenade and lunch only when the sea is rough.
  • Lagos pool if the family prefers no transfer.

/* Tooltip */
/* Base styles for the element that has a tooltip */
.leaflet-tooltip {
	position: absolute;
	padding: 6px;
	background-color: #fff;

	border-radius: 3px;
